real_objective: Make Brain permanently own useful capabilities equal to or better than Claude Opus 5.5 while keeping knowledge external and JIT.
governing_invariants: Knowledge remains external/JIT and is not accumulated as the capability inventory.
Capabilities are found at the beginning, configured into Brain, verified against the Opus 5.5 bar, saved permanently, and inherited globally.
Routine operation must not rediscover capabilities JIT.
Underlying capability invention is forbidden; only integration/configuration/verification glue may be built.
Failure to find an existing sufficient capability is unresolved/theory-falsification evidence, not permission to invent.
material_premises: The prior V4 mission lock explicitly allowed JIT capability acquisition and invention, contradicting the corrected theory.
The active micro-repair program could continue constructing capability internals instead of acquiring existing Opus-5.5-or-better capability realizations.
Chat-only corrections are insufficient because later workers can recover stale canonical law instead.
conclusion: Promote the capability-ownership/JIT-knowledge asymmetry to top-level canonical law and make all consequential action gates and receipts enforce it.

rejected_material_alternatives.reason: Not durable or authoritative across sessions/agents.
Conflicting V4 JIT/invention language could continue to authorize drift.
Subordinate implementation work must not outrank correction of the terminal theory and capability ownership model.

uncertainties: The full defensible Opus 5.5 useful capability envelope still needs recovery and normalization.
Some candidate capability realizations may depend on remote execution; they count only when durably configured as reusable Brain routes rather than rediscovered per task.
assumptions: User's corrected theory is authoritative for Project Brain.
$0 incremental spend remains a hard constraint until explicitly changed.
non_goals: Do not create a permanent world-knowledge warehouse.
Do not invent missing underlying capabilities.
next_action: Recover the Opus 5.5 useful capability envelope, map existing Brain-owned capabilities, search existing equal-or-better realizations for gaps, then configure and save winners permanently.
supersession_conditions: Explicit user correction of the theory.
Evidence that a required Opus 5.5 capability has no realizable existing equal-or-better route under the hard constraints, creating a theory-falsification candidate.
supersedes: Any interpretation of V4 that permits JIT capability externalization.
Any interpretation of V4 that permits invention of an underlying missing capability.
